deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications run September 2, 2026 to January 31, 2027 (11:59pm PST); apply early for the study permit.

fee_waiver.value: The school does not offer application-fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: At this point in time, Mechatronics department is not able to offer application fee or admission deposit waivers.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for engineering.

supervisor.value: You may apply without a supervisor, but you must secure one to be admitted.
supervisor.quote: Prospective students do not need to secure a supervisor to submit an application, however they do need to secure a supervisor to be admitted to the program.

funding.value: Funding comes mainly as research assistantships from the supervisor's grants; TA posts, scholarships and fellowships are competitive and not guaranteed.
funding.quote: Individual faculty members support students as research assistants, paid from research grants. | There is a limited amount of funding through teaching assistantship positions, scholarships, and graduate fellowships. However, these are based on competition and not guaranteed.

also.quote: These are competitive and they are not guaranteed.

entry_route.value: A master's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, physics, computer science or a related field is required.
entry_route.quote: must have a Master's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, physics, computer science or a related field

notes: Spring and Summer intakes also exist.
name: Mechatronic Systems Engineering PhD
